title: bertolonia maculata var. aenea
intro: Bertolonia maculata var. aenea, commonly known as the Aenea Bertolonia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Melastomataceae. It is a plant that has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Brazil, where it is valued for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to possess therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and fight against infections. The bioactive constituents of Bertolonia maculata var. aenea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have potential health benefits.
